search_text: published ZDI-15-112 ZDI-CAN-2447 ManageEngine Desktop Central MSP InventorySWMeteringServlet domain File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-04-03 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['ManageEngine'] ['Destkop Central MSP'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ManageEngine Desktop Central MSP. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the InventorySWMeteringServlet servlet. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the filenames uploaded to the servlet. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of SYSTEM. ManageEngine has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
